_why: A hook that is ADVISORY has one failure mode nothing else in this repo shares: it can go silent and every other signal stays identical. No test fails, no verdict moves, no exit code changes -- the session simply is not told, which is the exact state this hook was built to end. So the load-bearing rows are the two that silence it (`the-OVER-arm-goes-quiet`, `unreadable-is-reported-as-clean`) rather than anything about its text. `the-path-filter-widens` is the opposite failure and is just as fatal in practice: an advisory that fires on every memory write is one the reader learns to scroll past, which disarms the other paths too. `the-hook-starts-blocking` guards the one promise that makes it safe to install at all.

mutations.name: the-OVER-arm-goes-quiet
mutations._mechanism: The whole point, removed, with nothing else changing. An index that is ALREADY dropping its tail on every load produces a silent hook, an exit code of 0 and a session that is never told -- byte-identical to a healthy index from every other vantage point.

mutations.name: unreadable-is-reported-as-clean
mutations._mechanism: `I could not check` folded into `the check said OK` -- the asymmetry this repo enforces for the worktree comment, the state-file search and the binary blob. An index that has been moved or corrupted would report healthy, and the two situations prescribe opposite actions.

mutations.name: the-path-filter-widens-to-every-memory-write
mutations._mechanism: Fires on topic files too. Topic files are uncapped and writing one never drops a tail, so this turns the advisory into noise on the commonest memory write there is -- and a reader who scrolls past it also scrolls past the OVER it was built for. The failure is in the OPPOSITE direction from silence and ends in the same place.

mutations.name: the-hook-starts-blocking
mutations._mechanism: The one promise that makes this safe to install. A non-zero exit from a PreToolUse hook REFUSES the write, so a guard meant to inform would instead stop the user completing a memory -- and being wrong in that direction costs work, while being wrong the other way costs a line of text.

mutations.name: a-missing-checker-becomes-noisy
mutations._mechanism: Removing the silent bail-out makes every session on a machine without the checker print a complaint. That is the failure that trains the reader to ignore this hook, which silently disarms the two rows above -- the damage is to the OTHER findings, not to this line.
